current_responsibility: independently reviewing the Ledger V2 cutover candidate and blocking release unless every inherited gate is satisfied
settled_decisions: Assign UUIDv7 ledger identifiers at ingest and retain the legacy invoice identifier as external_ref [ADR-014].
Use the append-only outbox backfill; dual writes are rejected because replay is not proven idempotent [ADR-018].
Cut over through shadow reads followed by tenant cohorts rather than a big-bang switch [ADR-021].
Rollback disables Ledger V2 reads and preserves all Ledger V2 rows [RUNBOOK-07].
active_commitments: Do not enable Ledger V2 reads for a tenant until row count, cent total, and checksum all match [GATE-RECON-3].
Retain invoice audit records for seven years [POLICY-RET-7Y].
Keep Ledger V2 p95 read latency within 15 milliseconds of the legacy path [SLO-LEDGER-15MS].
Stop rollout when the reconciliation mismatch rate exceeds 0.01 percent [GATE-RECON-3].
Publish the reconciliation report before release approval [GATE-RECON-3].
hard_constraints: The reviewer must not execute production writes.
No schema changes are permitted during release review.
Customer PII must remain in the local approved environment.
unresolved_work: Prove the retry worker cannot duplicate outbox rows after a crash [INCIDENT-009].
Finalize the reconciliation checksum formula for partial refunds [ISSUE-442].
Resolve missing timezone mappings for tenants amber-grove and cedar-labs [ISSUE-451].
Run the representative load test against the release candidate [TEST-LOAD-PENDING].
Add cache invalidation ordering to the rollback runbook [RUNBOOK-07-GAP].
uncertainties: Whether observed duplicate rows came from the retry worker or pre-existing source data.
Whether the synthetic latency result predicts tenant-cohort performance.
Whether either missing timezone mapping changes invoice-day grouping.

new_inferences: The proposed cohort cutover omits the required shadow-read interval.
Matching row counts alone do not satisfy the reconciliation gate.
Excluding partial refunds prevents a complete checksum-based reconciliation.
The unreproduced duplicate observation leaves outbox idempotency unproven.
A temporary Redis identifier map does not resolve the missing timezone mappings.
Deferring the representative load test leaves the latency commitment unverified for this release candidate.
Deleting Ledger V2 rows on rollback contradicts the settled rollback decision, and delayed cache invalidation leaves the runbook gap unresolved.
The supplied candidate does not establish that a reconciliation report has been published before approval.

blocking_findings.rationale: The candidate enables a tenant cohort without the required shadow-read interval.

Row counts alone cannot satisfy the required row-count, cent-total, and checksum match. Excluding partial refunds leaves the checksum formula unresolved, and the candidate supplies no published reconciliation report.
The candidate accepts an observed duplicate without reproducing it or proving crash retry cannot duplicate outbox rows.
The missing mappings remain unresolved; an identifier map does not establish the invoice-day grouping for either affected tenant.
Deferring the representative load test leaves the p95 latency commitment unverified before the first cohort goes live.
Deleting Ledger V2 rows contradicts the requirement to preserve them. The proposed later cache invalidation also leaves ordering unresolved.
